paite: Huai thilte khit in, Galili dil, Tiberias tuipi kichi gallam ah Jesu apai hi.
heading: Mipi Sangnga Vakna / (Mat 14.13-21; Mar 6.30-44; Luk 9.1-17)

paite: Damloute tung a thillamdang ahihte amuh ziak un mipi tampi in amah azui uhi.
Jesu tang ah ahohtou a, huai ah anungzuite kiang ah atu hi.
Huan Paikan Ankuangluina, Judate ankuangluina anaita hi.
Jesu adak a, mipi tampi in akiang lam hon zuan in amu a, Philip kiang ah, "Hiaite nek ding tanghou koi a lei ding i hi ua?" achi hi.
Huai thu amah ze-etna ding a agen ahi, ahih ding lah ama'n athei ngal a.
Philip in akiang ah, "Michih in tawmchik a atan chiat ding uh leng, makhai zanih man tanghou in adaih kei ding," chi in adawng hi.
Huan anungzuite lak a khat, Simon Peter unau Andru in akiang ah,
"Barli buh tanghou phel nga leh ngasa nih nei pasal naupang khat hiai ah a-om, himahleh mi hiai zah lawmlawm lak ah bang tham hizou ding ahia?" achi hi.
Jesu'n, "Mite tusak un," achi hi. Huai ah loupa tampi a-om hi. Huchi in pichingte atusuk ua, atamlam uh sangnga vel ahi.
Jesu'n tanghou phelte ala a, kipahthu agen khit in atute kiang ah ahawm a, huchi mah bang in ngasate leng adeih hun un ahawm sam hi.
Huan akham nung un, anungzuite kiang ah, "Bangmah mang lou ding in anente luak un," achi hi.
Huchi in aluak ua, barli buh tanghou phel nga nete nek bang nente bawm sawm-le-nih ahihdim uhi.
Mite'n athillamdang hih amuhtak un, "Hiai mi, zawlnei, khovel a hong dingpa ana hi ngei e,” achi uhi.
Huchi in amah kumpipa dia bawl ding a mat teitei tum in ahong kuan ding uh, chih Jesu'n athei a, tang ah amah kia in apaituam nawnta hi.
Huan nitaklam in anungzuite tuipi ah apaisuk uhi.
heading: Tui Tung Ah Khe In Jesu Apai / (Mat 14.22-33; Mar 6.45-52)

paite: Long ah atuang ua, tuipi ah Kapernaum azuan uhi. Khua amialta a, Jesu lah akiang uah ahong tung nai kei hi.
Huihpi hattak anun ziak in tuikihot asang hulhul hi.
Ching sawmnih leh ching nga hiam, ching sawmthum hiam akalh nung un, tuipi tung a khe a Jesu pai a, long lam hon naih in amu ua, alauta uhi.
Himahleh ama'n akiang uah, "Keimah ka hi, lau kei un," achi hi.
Huchi in kilawptak in long ah Jesu atuangsakta ua, huchi in along uh azotna gam uah atung pah hi.
Azing in dil gal lehlam a mipi dinghte'n, long khat lou ngal long dang a-om kei a, anungzuite toh long ah Jesu atuang ton kei a, anungzuite amau kia in apai uh chih athei uhi.
heading: Mipite'n Jesu Azong Uh

paite: Himahleh Toupa'n kipahthu agen nung a, tanghou anekna kiang uh, Tiberias a kipan long neu chikchik ahong tung uhi.
Huchi in mipi'n Jesu leh anungzuite a-omta kei uh chih atheih un, amau leng long neute a tuang in, Jesu zong in Kapernaum khua ahong tung uhi.
Huan tuipi gal a ahong muh un akiang ah, "Rabbi, chik in ahia hiai lam na hong tun?" achi uhi.
heading: Jesu, Hinna Tanghou

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, thillamdangte na muh ziak ua hon zong na hi kei ua, tanghou phel na nekvah ziak uh ahi zaw.
An mang thei phet zong in phiaphia kei un, himahleh an, tangtawn hinpha a om gige ding, Mihing Tapa hon piak ding pen zong in phe zaw un; Pa Pathian in amah achiamtehta hi," chi in adawng hi.
Amau akiang ah, "Pathian nna ka septheihna ding un bang ahia ka hih ding uh?" achi uhi.
Jesu'n akiang uah, "Pathian nasep hiai ahi, amisawl gingta le uchin," chi in adawng hi.
Amau akiang ah, "Chiamtehna bang ahia na hih ding, ka muh ua nang ka hon gintak theihna ding un? Thil bang ahia na hih ding?
Van a kipan akiang uah amau tanghou nek ding apia chih gelh bang in, ka pipute un gamdai ah manna ane uh," achi uhi.
Jesu'n akiang uah, "Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, van a kipan a tanghou na muh pen uh Mosi hon piak ahi kei, ka Pa'n van a kipan tanghoutak noute ahon piak ahi zaw.
Pathian tanghou van a kipan in ahong paisuk a, khovel kiang a hinna pepa ahi," achi hi.
Amau, "Toupa, huai tanghou hon pe gige in," achi uhi.
Jesu'n akiang uah, "Keimah hinna tanghou ka hi; kuapeuh ka kiang a hong pai agilkial kei ding, kuapeuh kei hon gingta chik mah chiang in adangtak kei ding.
Himahleh nou na hon muh un leng na hon gingta kei uh chih ka hon hilhta ve.
Pa'n hon piak peuhmah ka kiang ah ahong pai vek ding uh; kuapeuh ka kiang a hong pai ka delhkhe ngei kei ding hi.
Kei deihlam hih ding a van a kipan a hong paisuk ka hi kei, hon sawlpa deihlam hih ding a hong paisuk ka hi zaw hi.
Hiai ahon sawlpa deihlam ahi, ama'n hon piak tengteng bangmah mangsak lou in, nitawp ni chiang in kaithou zaw leng.
Kuapeuh Tapa mu a gingta in tangtawn hinna aneih a, nitawp ni chiang a amah ka kaihthoh ding ka Pa deihlam ahih ziak in," achi hi.
Van a kipan a tanghou hong paisuk ka hi, achih ziak in, atung ah Judate aphun uhi.
"Hiai mi Joseph tapa Jesu ahi kei a hia, anu leh apa leng i theih? Van a kipan a hong paisuk ka hi, bangchi chih a chi ahia?" achi uhi.
Jesu'n akiang uah, "Phunphun dah un.
Pa hon sawlpa'n ahip keileh kuamah ka kiang ah ahong pai thei kei. Ke'n ahong pai mi nitawp ni chiah ka kaithou ding.
Zawlneite laibu ah 'Pathian hilh in a-om ding uh,' chih gelh ahi. Michih Pa thu za a thei peuhmah ka kiang ah ahong pai uhi.
Pathian a kipan pen lou ngal in kuamah in Pa amu ngei kei, ama'n zaw Pa amu hi.
Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, kuapeuh agingta in tangtawn hinna anei.
Keimah hinna tanghou ka hi.
Na pipute un gamdai ah manna ane ua, huchi in asi uhi.
Hiai tanghou i chih pen van a kipan a hong paisuk ahi, mi'n anek ua asihlouhna ding un.
Keimah van a kipan a tanghou hing hong paisuk ka hi, kuapeuh in hiai tanghou anekleh tangtawn in ahing gige ding; ahi, khovel hinna dia ka piak ding tanghou ka sa ahi,” achi hi.
Huchi in Judate akisel ua, "Hiai mi'n bangchi in asa nek ding in hon pe thei ding ahia?" achi uhi.
Jesu'n akiang uah, "Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, Mihing Tapa sa na nek ua, asisan na dawn kei uleh noumau in hinna nei lou hi ve uchin.
Kuapeuh ka sa ne a, ka sisan dawn in tangtawn hinna anei; huan, nitawp ni chiang in amah ka kaithou ding.
Ka sa zaw an taktak ahi a, ka sisan leng dawn tak taktak ahi.
Kuapeuh ka sa ne a, ka sisan dawnmi, keimah ah a-om gige a, kei leng amah ah ka om gige hi.
Pa hing in hon sawl a, Pa ziak a hing ka hih mah bang in, kuapeuh kei hon nete keimah ziak in amah leng ahing ding hi.
Hiai van a kipan a tanghou hong paisuk ahi; na pipute un tanghou anek ua, asih bang uh zaw ahi kei; kuapeuh hiai tanghou ne tangtawn in ahing gige ding,” achi hi.
Huai thute Kapernaum a sinagog a thu ahilh lai a agen ahi.
Huchi in anungzuite akhen tampi in huai azak un, “Hiai thuhaksa ahi, kua'n angaikhe thei dia?" achi uhi.
heading: Ginglah Nungzuite

paite: Huai thu ah anungzuite aphun uh chih Jesu'n alungsim a atheih in, akiang uah, "Hiai thu in hon hih lunghi lou hia?
Mihing Tapa tuma lam a a-omna ngei a kahtou mu le uchin, bang na chi ding ua?
Hinna pia zaw kha ahi a, sa zaw bangmah ding in aphatuam kei; na kiang ua thu ka gente kha ahi a, hinna leng ahi.
Himahleh na lak uah akhen gingta lou om na hi uh," achi hi. Jesu'n atung a kipan in agingtaloute leh amansak dingpa atheigige ngal a.
Huan ama'n, huaiziak in ahi na kiang ua, "Pa in apiak keileh kuamah ka kiang ah ahong pai thei kei, ka chih," achi hi.
Hiai nung in anungzuite akhen tampi akinunghei ua, amah akithuahpih nawnta kei uhi.
Jesu'n sawm-le-nihte kiang ah, "Nou leng paimang sam na ut uhia?" achi a.
heading: Peter In Khrist Gupna

paite: Simon Peter in, “Toupa, kua kiang ah ahia ka pai tuan ding uh? Nangma'n tangtawn hinna thu na nei hi.
Nangmah Pathian Mi Siangthou na hi chih ka taksangta ua, theih leng ka thei uh," chi in adawng hi.
Huan Jesu'n akiang uah, "Nou sawm-le-nihte keimah hon tel hilou na hi uh maw? Na lak ua mi khat diabol ahih laitei toh," achi hi.
Iskariot, Simon tapa Judas, sawm-le-nihte lak a tel sam, huai thu agen ahi, amah zuausan a mansakpa ding ahi.
